objective: Test whether verified experience improves future acquisition of functionally novel procedures rather than merely enabling exact procedure retrieval.

hypothesis.statement: A verified adaptive operator library will improve acquisition of functionally novel target procedures over a frozen induction policy and matched exact-memory/sham-memory controls.
hypothesis.null: Any apparent gain is caused by direct retrieval, source-target overlap, extra verifier calls, a larger candidate budget or untracked search computation.

invalidating_conditions: source-target AST or truth-table hash collision
target labels used before proposal fixation
target retrieval hit counted as adaptation
post-reset execution or verifier integrity failure
sealed-data access before final proposal fixation
retained_scaffolding: canonical AST and exhaustive equivalence checker
new_component: verified operator library plus policy adapter
interpretation_boundary: A positive result would establish model-agnostic cumulative policy adaptation under the tested DSL. It would not establish neural learning-to-learn, general intelligence or transfer beyond the tested procedure language.
